message.content:
A magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large red letters features an editorial illustration. At the top, a red bar sits beside headlines like "Bongkar-Pasang Regulasi Impor" and "Tuntutan Kopong Tom Lembong." In the center, a large billboard stands on a single brown pole in an arid landscape. The billboard displays a cartoon face with dark hair, a mustache, and a concerned expression, peering over the top edge with ten fingers visible. 

In the foreground, a gray asphalt road appears as a thin fabric sheet. Two men in white long-sleeved shirts and dark pants stand on the right. One man is bent over, lifting the edge of the gray road-fabric with his right hand, revealing sand underneath. Two rows of black footprints emerge from beneath the lifted fabric and continue across the sand. Large white text on the left reads "NASIB BOBBY SETELAH JOKOWI LENGSER" above a smaller paragraph mentioning the KPK and "Bobby Nasution." At the bottom, a barcode, QR code, and price "RP 60.000" are visible alongside the dates "14-20 JULI 2025."
